SELECT
	STG.[BILLER_ID]
	,STG.[BILLER_SERVICE_ID]
	,STG.[PAYMENT_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,[PAYMENT_DATE]) AS PAYMENT_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PAYMENT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS PAYMENT_AMT
	,STG.[BILL_CCY]
	,STG.[PAYMENT_TYPE]
	,STG.[ACCT_NO]
	,STG.[CHECK_NO]
	,STG.[CHECK_TYPE]
	,STG.[BANK_CODE]
	,STG.[BRSTN]
	,STG.[MC_DD_NO]
	,STG.[BARCODE]
	,STG.[SUBSCRIBER_NO]
	,STG.[PHONE_NO]
	,STG.[CARD_NO]
	,STG.[CARD_TYPE]
	,STG.[MERALCO_REF_NO]
	,STG.[POLICY_NO]
	,STG.[POLICY_TYPE]
	,STG.[AREA]
	,STG.[INSURANCE_TYPE]
	,STG.[INVOICE_NO]
	,STG.[NAME_OF_INSURED]
	,STG.[STUDENT_ID]
	,STG.[CAMPUS]
	,STG.[STUDENT_NAME]
	,STG.[PRODUCT_CODE]
	,STG.[INSTITUTION_CODE]
	,STG.[CORPORATE_NAME]
	,STG.[TRANSACTION_CODE]
	,STG.[COUNTRY_CODE]
	,STG.[REMITTER]
	,STG.[BENEFICIARY]
	,STG.[BENEFICIARY_TIN]
	,STG.[REF_TRANSMITTAL_NO]
	,STG.[REPRESENTATIVE_NAME]
	,STG.[AMLA_CODE]
	,STG.[BANK_MNEMONIC]
	,STG.[COMB_STRING]
	,STG.[LATE_CHECK_PAYMENT_FLG]
	,STG.[TRAN_ID_BY_PUB]
	,CONVERT(DATE,[TRAN_DATE_BY_PUB]) AS TRAN_DATE_BY_PUB
	,STG.[BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,[BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_DATE]) AS BILLER_PAYMENT_TRAN_DATE
	,STG.[REVERSE_FLG]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(REVERSE_CRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS REVERSE_CRE_TIME
	,STG.[REVERSE_CRE_USER_ID]
	,STG.[REVERSAL_TRAN_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,[REVERSAL_TRAN_DATE]) AS REVERSAL_TRAN_DATE
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,STG.[DEL_FLG]
	,STG.[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
	,STG.[SOL_ID]
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,STG.[SET_NUM]
	,CONVERT(DATE,[ZONE_DATE]) AS ZONE_DATE
	,STG.[ZONE_CODE]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM D360.STG_DEP_CPYBPDET STG
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	STG.[ACCOUNT_NUMBER]
	,STG.[TRAN_DATETIME]
	,STG.[ATM_BANK_ID]
	,STG.[ATM_TERMINAL_ID]
	,STG.[COMMAND]
	,STG.[STAN]
	,STG.[TRAN_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF([TRAN_DATE], 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,STG.[PARTTRAN_NUM]
	,STG.[PARTTRAN_IND]
	,STG.[PARTTRAN_REM]
	,STG.[PARTTRAN_PART1]
	,STG.[PARTTRAN_PART2]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TRAN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TRAN_AMT
	,STG.[SOURCE_APP_CODE]
	,STG.[ATM_CRD_NUM]
	,STG.[BILLER_CODE]
	,STG.[BILR_SUBR_NUM1]
	,STG.[BILR_SUBR_NUM2]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT1]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT2]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT3]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT4]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT5]
	,STG.[TPS_USER]
	,STG.[TPS_TRANREF]
	,STG.[TPS_ACCNO]
	,STG.[TPS_ACCNAME]
	,STG.[TPS_TRAN_RMKS]
	,STG.[TPS_TRAN_DESC]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,STG.[LAST6_ACC_NUM]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM D360.STG_DEP_CUSTOMCHANNELTRANSTABLE STG
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	STG.[BENEFICIARY]
	,STG.[REMITTER]
	,STG.[BENE_TIN]
	,STG.[REMITTER_TIN]
	,STG.[COUNTRY]
	,STG.[TRAN_CODE]
	,STG.[CHRG_COLL_FLG]
	,STG.[CHRG_TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[MODE_OF_PAY]
	,STG.[REPRESENTATIVE_NAME]
	,STG.[TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[DTH_INIT_SOL_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(TRAN_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,STG.[TD_REF_NO]
	,STG.[TD_WITHDRWL_TYPE]
	,STG.[PCC_CODE]
	,STG.[MRT_NAME]
	,STG.[FREE_TEXT]
	,STG.[MOP_ID]
	,STG.[PCC_CODE_DR]
	,STG.[PCC_CODE_CR]
	,STG.[OAP_REF_NUM_DR]
	,STG.[OAP_REF_NUM_CR]
	,STG.[ACCTS_OFFICER_CODE]
	,STG.[CIF_ID]
	,STG.[REMARKS3]
	,STG.[CHQ_NO_CR]
	,STG.[CHQ_NO_DR]
	,STG.[PN_REF_NUM]
	,STG.[REF_EBP_NUM]
	,STG.[ORIG_TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[OTHER_BANK_ID]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_CUSTREPRINTTBL STG
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	 CONVERT(DATE,STG.[TRAN_DATE]) AS TRAN_DATE
	,STG.[TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[PART_TRAN_SRL_NUM]
	,STG.[DEL_FLG]
	,STG.[TRAN_TYPE]
	,STG.[TRAN_SUB_TYPE]
	,STG.[PART_TRAN_TYPE]
	,STG.[GL_SUB_HEAD_CODE]
	,STG.[ACID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[VALUE_DATE]) AS VALUE_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[TRAN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TRAN_AMT
	,STG.[TRAN_PARTICULAR]
	,STG.[ENTRY_USER_ID]
	,STG.[PSTD_USER_ID]
	,STG.[VFD_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[ENTRY_DATE]) AS ENTRY_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[PSTD_DATE]) AS PSTD_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[VFD_DATE]) AS VFD_DATE
	,STG.[RPT_CODE]
	,STG.[REF_NUM]
	,STG.[INSTRMNT_TYPE]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSTRMNT_DATE]) AS INSTRMNT_DATE 
	,STG.[INSTRMNT_NUM]
	,STG.[INSTRMNT_ALPHA]
	,STG.[TRAN_RMKS]
	,STG.[PSTD_FLG]
	,STG.[PRNT_ADVC_IND]
	,STG.[AMT_RESERVATION_IND]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RESERVATION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS RESERVATION_AMT
	,STG.[RESTRICT_MODIFY_IND]
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[LCHG_TIME]) AS LCHG_TIME
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[RCRE_TIME]) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[CUST_ID]
	,STG.[VOUCHER_PRINT_FLG]
	,STG.[MODULE_ID]
	,STG.[BR_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[FX_TRAN_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS FX_TRAN_AMT
	,STG.[RATE_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS RATE
	,STG.[CRNCY_CODE]
	,STG.[NAVIGATION_FLG]
	,STG.[TRAN_CRNCY_CODE]
	,STG.[REF_CRNCY_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[REF_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS REF_AMT
	,STG.[SOL_ID]
	,STG.[BANK_CODE]
	,STG.[TREA_REF_NUM]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[TREA_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS TREA_RATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TS_CNT
	,STG.[GST_UPD_FLG]
	,STG.[ISO_FLG]
	,STG.[EABFAB_UPD_FLG]
	,STG.[LIFT_LIEN_FLG]
	,STG.[PROXY_POST_IND]
	,STG.[SI_SRL_NUM]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE]) AS SI_ORG_EXEC_DATE
	,STG.[PR_SRL_NUM]
	,STG.[SERIAL_NUM]
	,STG.[DEL_MEMO_PAD]
	,STG.[UAD_MODULE_ID]
	,STG.[UAD_MODULE_KEY]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[REVERSAL_DATE]) AS REVERSAL_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE]) AS REVERSAL_VALUE_DATE
	,STG.[PTTM_EVENT_TYPE]
	,STG.[PROXY_ACID]
	,STG.[TOD_ENTITY_TYPE]
	,STG.[TOD_ENTITY_ID]
	,STG.[DTH_INIT_SOL_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[REGULARIZATION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS REGULARIZATION_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS PRINCIPAL_PORTION_AMT
	,STG.[TF_ENTITY_SOL_ID]
	,STG.[TRAN_PARTICULAR_2]
	,STG.[TRAN_PARTICULAR_CODE]
	,STG.[TR_STATUS]
	,STG.[SVS_TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[CRNCY_HOL_CHK_DONE_FLG]
	,STG.[REFERRAL_ID]
	,STG.[PARTY_CODE]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[GL_DATE]) AS GL_DATE
	,STG.[BKDT_TRAN_FLG]
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,STG.[IMPL_CASH_PART_TRAN_FLG]
	,STG.[PTRAN_CHRG_EXISTS_FLG]
	,STG.[MUD_POOL_BAL_BUILD_FLG]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM],' ',''),''),0)) AS USED_CLEAN_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM],' ',''),''),0)) AS USED_SINGLE_TRAN_LIM
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS USED_UN_CLR_OVER_DACC_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN],' ',''),''),0)) AS USED_CLEAN_EMER_ADVN
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[USED_EMER_ADVN],' ',''),''),0)) AS USED_EMER_ADVN
	,STG.[GL_SEGMENT_STRING]
	,STG.[COMB_TRAN_ID]
	,STG.[SYS_PART_TRAN_CODE]
	,STG.[USER_PART_TRAN_CODE]
	,STG.[TRAN_FREE_CODE1]
	,STG.[TRAN_FREE_CODE2]
	,STG.[RESP_ACCT_REF_NO]
	,STG.[PURPOSE_CODE]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]
FROM d360.STG_DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE STG
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	[ENTITY_ID]
	,[ENTITY_TYPE]
	,[INTEREST_IND]
	,[INTEREST_TYPE]
	,[SERIAL_NUM]
	,[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PRODUCT],' ',''),''),0)) AS PRODUCT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([PRODUCT_FOR_INT_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS PRODUCT_FOR_INT_RATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DIFF_PRODUCT],' ',''),''),0)) AS DIFF_PRODUCT
	,CONVERT(DATE,[START_DATE]) AS START_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,[END_DATE]) AS END_DATE
	,[INT_TABLE_CODE]
	,[INT_VERSION]
	,[INT_METHOD]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FULL_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS FULL_RATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DIFF_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS DIFF_RATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTEREST_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS INTEREST_AMOUNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FIXED_INT_PER_ANNUM],' ',''),''),0)) AS FIXED_INT_PER_ANNUM
	,CONVERT(DATE,[LAST_COMP_DATE]) AS LAST_COMP_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([LAST_COMP_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS LAST_COMP_AMOUNT
	,[SUPERCEDE_FLG]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BASE_DAYS_IN_A_YEAR],' ',''),''),0)) AS BASE_DAYS_IN_A_YEAR
	,CONVERT(DATE,[REF_DATE]) AS REF_DATE
	,[LCHG_USER_ID]
	--,CONVERT(DATE,[LCHG_TIME]) AS LCHG_TIME
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff([LCHG_TIME], 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as LCHG_TIME
	,[RCRE_USER_ID]
	--,CONVERT(DATE,[RCRE_TIME]) AS RCRE_TIME
    ,convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff([RCRE_TIME], 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) as RCRE_TIME
	,[CRNCY_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TS_CNT
	,[INT_APPL_FLG]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DEF_APPL_INT_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS DEF_APPL_INT_RATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DEF_APPL_INT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS DEF_APPL_INT_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([BASE_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS BASE_RATE
	,[BANK_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INT_AMOUNT_MODIFIED],' ',''),''),0)) AS INT_AMOUNT_MODIFIED
	,CONVERT(DATE,[LAST_COMP_DATE_CR]) AS LAST_COMP_DATE_CR
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([LAST_COMP_AMOUNT_CR],' ',''),''),0)) AS LAST_COMP_AMOUNT_CR
	,[INT_APPL_FLG_CR]
	,[WTAX_AMOUNT_SCOPE_FLG]
	,[ITAX_FOR_FLOOR_LIMIT_FLG]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([WTAX_PCNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS WTAX_PCNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([WTAX_FLOOR_LIMIT],' ',''),''),0)) AS WTAX_FLOOR_LIMIT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([LAST_COMP_TAX],' ',''),''),0)) AS LAST_COMP_TAX
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TAX_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TAX_AMOUNT
	,[WTAX_FOR_CR_COMP]
	,[PROD_CALC_METHOD]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_INTERESTDETAILSTABLE
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	STG.[ACID]
	,STG.[REN_SRL_NUM]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.DEPOSIT_PERIOD_MTHS,' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_PERIOD_MTHS
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.DEPOSIT_PERIOD_DAYS,' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_PERIOD_DAYS
	,CONVERT(DATE,[OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE]) AS OPEN_EFFECTIVE_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,[ACCT_OPEN_DATE]) AS ACCT_OPEN_DATE
	,CONVERT(DATE,[MATURITY_DATE]) AS MATURITY_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([DEPOSIT_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS DEPOSIT_AMOUNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([MATURITY_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS MATURITY_AMOUNT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_TYPE]
	,STG.[INT_CR_TBL_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([OVERDUE_INT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS OVERDUE_INT_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(22,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([INTEREST_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS INTEREST_AMOUNT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([TDS_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TDS_AMT
	,STG.[TRAN_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF([TRAN_DATE], 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS TRAN_DATE
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ADD_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS ADD_AMT
	,STG.[ADD_AMT_CRNCY]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([RENEWAL_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_AMT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_AMT_CRNCY]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_SCHM_CODE]
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(3,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.TS_CNT,' ',''),''),0)) AS TS_CNT
	,STG.[SCHM_CODE]
	,STG.[MASTER_B2K_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([FIXED_INSTALLMENT_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS FIXED_INSTALLMENT_AMT
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([NRML_INSTALLMENT_PCNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS NRML_INSTALLMENT_PCNT
	,STG.[INSTALLMENT_BASIS]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([CUMULATIVE_TOP_UP_PAID],' ',''),''),0)) AS CUMULATIVE_TOP_UP_PAID
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE([ADD_AMT2],' ',''),''),0)) AS ADD_AMT2
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM d360.STG_DEP_RENEWALHISTTABLE STG
WHERE H = 'D'

SELECT
	 STG.[ACID]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_OPTION]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RENEWAL_AMOUNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_AMOUNT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_CRNCY]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_CRNCY]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_SRC]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[RENEWAL_BOD]) AS RENEWAL_BOD
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE
	,STG.[LCHG_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[LCHG_TIME]) AS LCHG_TIME
	,STG.[RCRE_USER_ID]
	,CONVERT(DATE,STG.[RCRE_TIME]) AS RCRE_TIME
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[TS_CNT],' ',''),''),0)) AS TS_CNT
	,STG.[RENEWAL_MASTER_ACCT_ID]
	,STG.[BANK_ID]
	,STG.[AUTO_REN_POOL_CODE]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT2],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT2
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE_CODE2]
	,CONVERT(NUMERIC(21,10),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE2],' ',''),''),0)) AS RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_RATE2
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_FWC_NUM]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_ADDNL_AMT_FWC_SOL_ID]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_FWC_NUM]
	,STG.[RENEWAL_FWC_SOL_ID]
	,STG.[ENTITY_CRE_FLG]
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
